card.name: Last digit before kg weights
card.fires_on: The final digit of a number right before the unit kg, mostly in weight bands like 10 kg to <14 kg or 60 kg to 100 kg. It also fires on weights in kg given in parentheses after pounds.

modes.label: Weight-band dosing tables
modes.description: Last digit of a body-weight cutoff, such as 40, 50, 60 or 10, just before kg in a dose table.
